name: srs
description: SRS is a simple, high-performance, AI-driven real-time media server supporting RTMP, WebRTC, HLS, HTTP-FLV, HTTP-TS, SRT, MPEG-DASH, and GB28181, with codec support for H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, AAC, Opus, and G.711.

issues.title: SRS: Adding Media over QUIC (MoQ) protocol
Proxy: Add the API to obtain the deployment information of origins and streams from the proxy
Oryx: add an option to strip H.264 SEI from uploaded MP4 sources
WebRTC (ICE-lite): send address switches on every STUN binding request, causing ~15 s of choppy playback for multi-homed WHEP players
Simultaneous transmit stops while on intercom
SRT: srt_to_rtmp logs a warning for every TS message of an unsupported audio codec (MP2 and others)
SRT: srt_to_rtmp interleaves all AAC tracks of a multi-audio MPEG-TS into one RTMP audio stream
SRT: srt_to_rtmp drops about half of the video frames when FFmpeg packs many AAC frames per PES

## Performance: v6.0-r3 vs v6.0-r2

Each scenario is an A/B run: both builds at once in Docker, each SRS on its own vCPU, the same load and the same flat CBR source (H.264 200 kbps + AAC 32 kbps, 25 fps). SRS CPU is averaged over 180 s and compared second by second. Negative means v6.0-r3 uses less CPU. Changes within about ±1 point are noise.

| Scenario | Clients | v6.0-r2 CPU | v6.0-r3 CPU | Change (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| RTMP → RTMP | 11,520 | 42.7% | 39.9% | **−6.5%** (−7.5% to −5.5%)¹ |
| RTMP → HTTP-FLV | 11,520 | 71.5% | 68.3% | −4.4% (−4.8% to −4.1%) |
| RTMP → HTTP-TS | 2,880 | 57.1% | 54.3% | −5.0% (−5.9% to −4.0%) |
| RTMP → HLS | 5,760 | 13.1% | 13.3% | +1.5% (−4.2% to +7.2%) |
| RTMP → WHEP | 1,152 | 61.8% | 62.9% | +1.8% (+1.3% to +2.3%) |
| WHIP → RTMP | 11,520 | 44.3% | 43.8% | −1.0% (−2.2% to +0.2%) |
| WHIP → HTTP-FLV | 11,520 | 66.8% | 66.3% | −0.7% (−1.1% to −0.3%) |
| SRT → SRT | 576 | 40.8% | 40.7% | −0.3% (−0.6% to 0.0%) |
| SRT → RTMP | 5,760 | 16.5% | 16.1% | −2.8% (−5.3% to −0.3%) |
| SRT → WHEP | 1,152 | 61.5% | 62.6% | +1.8% (+1.4% to +2.3%) |
| RTMP publishers | 1,152 | 84.6% | 85.8% | +1.5% (+0.7% to +2.2%) |
| WHIP publishers | 400 | 19.5% | 20.6% | +5.9% (+5.4% to +6.5%) |
| Many streams (1 pub + 2 players each) | 576 streams | 62.4% | 63.3% | +1.4% (+1.1% to +1.7%) |
